summary: Establish a checkpointed baseline for obsolete-reader refusal coverage

schema.detail: No storage format or migration changes.

compatibility.detail: After stopping the candidate, the compatibility test checkpoints its crash-stop WAL before taking exact main-file and version/marker snapshots. It retains exact byte equality after obsolete-reader refusal. This tests refusal against a checkpointed baseline, not unchanged physical bytes during crash recovery; it makes no claim about historical changed-page provenance.

recovery.detail: Privacy-floor rollback still requires a pre-upgrade backup.
